items.item:
4. A Customer correction replaces every editable fact, clearing an optional
   one it does not give; its identity, created instant, request id and marks
   stay; one giving exactly the stored facts leaves the revision.
   Shows A03-1, A03-2, A03-3. [witness: verification:registry_a03_customer_correction_replaces_editable_facts]
statements:
```text
after correct(p, facts f) accepted:
  editable(p) = f   -- A03-1
  non_editable(p) = non_editable(p before)   -- A03-2
  f = editable(p before) => p = p before   -- A03-3
```

verdicts.why: The check verifies every editable customer fact is replaced, including clearing omitted optional facts; identity, creation time, marks, and request-id association remain unchanged. It also submits exactly the stored facts and verifies both the returned and reread customer remain equal to the pre-correction record with no reported change.
